REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
CERRITOS PARKS AND RECREATION COMMISSION
THURSDAY - MAY 1, 2025 - 07:00 P.M.
CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL CHAMBER
18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CA 90703
Agenda Materials
The complete agenda for this meeting is available on-demand at cerritos.gov and at the Recreation Services Division, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, 2nd floor, Cerritos, CA, 90703 during regular business hours (Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., weekend and observed holidays excepted). Any materials submitted to the Commission after distribution of this agenda will be available for public inspection at the Recreation Services Division during regular business hours. Requests for agenda materials or meeting participation assistance can also be made by email to recreation@cerritos.us or by phone at (562) 916-1254 during regular business hours.
Order of Agenda
The Commission, by majority of those members present, may reorder the business items listed on the agenda.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at cerritos.gov, on cable television at Cerritos TV3, or in person in the Council Chamber.
Public Comments
Members of the public may provide public comment for this meeting in person at the meeting or or in writing as described below.
In-person public comment : Public comment on business agenda items will be opened and may be provided during consideration of that business agenda item. Public comment on Consent Calendar and non-agenda items will be opened and may be provided during Agenda Item No. 5.
Written public comment (hard copy or email) : Public comment may be submitted via email to recreation@cerritos.us or by hard copy to the Recreation Services Division no later than 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the agenda item number in the subject line of the email or hard copy document. All written correspondence received by the 3:00 p.m. deadline will be distributed to the Commission prior to the meeting and retained with the official meeting record.
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the Recreation Services Division at (562) 916-1254 to request accommodation. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the meeting.

CITY OF CERRITOS
  MINUTES OF A REGULAR MEETING OF THE
  PARKSAND RECREATION COMMISSION
  OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
  MAY 1, 2025

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Pledge of Allegiance

  Commissioner Camargo led in the Pledge of Allegiance.

3.  Roll Call

  PRESENT:  Commissioner Alex Camargo
  Commissioner Cathy DeLeon
  Commissioner Jose Iglesias
  Vice Chair Ileana Prado

  ABSENT:  Commissioner Pat Patnaik

  All Members of the Parks and Recreation Commission were declared present except for
  Commissioner Patnaik.

  MOTION: Vice Chair Prado moved to excuse Commissioner Patnaik’s absence.
  Commissioner Camargo seconded the motion, which carried 4-0, with Commissioner
  Patnaik, absent.

4.  Commission Reorganization
  Acting Recreation Services Superintendent Samir Patel declared the positions of Chair
  and Vice Chair of the Commission, vacant, and called for nominations.

  Commissioner Iglesias nominated Vice Chair Prado for Chair.

  There being no other nominations, nominations were closed, and Vice Chair Pradowas
  declared, Chair, unanimously, with Commissioner Patnaik, absent.
  Chair Prado called for nominations for Vice Chair.

  Chair Prado nominated Commissioner Patnaik for Vice Chair.

  There were no other nominations and Commissioner Patnaik was declared Vice Chair,
  unanimously, with Commissioner Patnaik, absent.

5.  Presentations

5A.  Presentations

  Mr. Patel recognized Recreation Leader II Russell Mecano as Employee of the Month.
   Mr. Patel recognized Senior Center Community Services Leader III Andrea Maciasas
  Employee of the Quarter.
6.  Public Comments and Suggestions
  Adrian Ayub congratulated Chair Prado and Vice Chair Patnaik; thanked the
  Commission for its work; expressed concerns regarding the growing presence of
  homeless individuals at Liberty Park and other City parks and urged the Commission to
  address the topic with City Council.

  Mr. Patel reported that the Community Safety Division and staff are aware of the
  situation.

  Mr. Patel reported no written communications were received by the deadline.

  There were no other public comments and Chair Prado closed this portion of the
  meeting .

7.  Consent Calendar

7A.  Approval of Minutes – March 6, 2025, 7:00 p.m. Parks and Recreation Commission
  Regular Meeting Minutes

  MOTION: Chair Prado moved to approve the Consent Calendar, as presented.
  Commissioner Carnargo seconded the motion, which carried 4-0, with Commissioner
  Patnaik, absent.
8.  New and Old Business

8A.  Reviewand considerationof an evaluation of the 2025 Youth BasketballLeagueand
  Awards Program

  Recreation Services Administrator Jill Toda displayed a PowerPointpresentation with
  an evaluation of the 2025 Youth Basketball League and Awards Program.

  Membersof the Commissioncommented favorably regarding the program.
  There were no public comments on this item.

  MOTION: Chair Prado moved to receive and file the report. Commissioner Camargo
  secondedthe motion, which carried 4-0, with Commissioner Patnaik, absent.
9.  Reports
9A.  Reports from Designated Commission Staff Liaison

  Ms. Toda provided an update on Recreation Services programs, classes and activities.

  Community Services Supervisor Jesse Zavala provided an update on Senior Services
  programs, classes and activities.

  Membersof the Commissioncommented favorably regarding the programsoffered by
  the Cerritos Senior Center.

City of Cerritos  May 1, 2025
Parks and Recreation Commission Minutes  Page 2
 9B.  Reports from Parks and Recreation Commission Members

  Chair Prado reported attending the Spring Fling.

  Commissioner DeLeon reported attending the Spring Fling and stated parking was an
  issue.

  Commissioner Iglesias thanked Councilmember Jennifer Hong for appointing him to
  the Commission.

10.  Adjournment
  The meeting was adjourned at 7:36 p.m.
